title_en: Fu Hengsheng et al. v. Lianyungang Development Zone Huayuan Municipal Landscape Engineering Co., Ltd. — dispute over compensation for work-related injury benefits
ruling_gist_en: For employees who have undergone internal retirement but have not yet reached the statutory retirement age, while retaining their labor relationship with the original employer, if they work for and are managed by another employer, the employment relationship between the employee and the new employer constitutes a labor relationship. If the employee suffers a work-related injury while working for the new employer, the new employer is the subject liable for work-related injury insurance compensation and shall bear all obligations for paying work-related injury benefits.

full_text_en:
Fu Hengsheng et al. v. Lianyungang Development Zone Huayuan Municipal Garden Engineering Company

— dispute over compensation for work-related injury benefits

【Ruling Summary】

An internal retiree who has not reached the statutory retirement age, while retaining the labor relationship with the original employer, works for and is managed by another entity, the employment relationship between the worker and the new employer constitutes a labor relationship. If a worker suffers a work-related injury while working for the new employer, the new employer is the subject liable for work-related injury insurance compensation and shall bear the obligations to pay work-related injury benefits.

Plaintiffs: Fu Hengsheng (father of Fu Yunshan), male, 88 years old, residing in Lianyun District, Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiff: Zhang Zhenghua (wife of Fu Yunshan), female, 60 years old, residing in Lianyun District, Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiff: Fu Caijun (son of Fu Yunshan), male, 34 years old, residing in Lianyun District, Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Lianyungang Development Zone Huayuan Municipal Garden Engineering Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Huanghe Road, Lianyungang Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiffs, Fu Hengsheng, Zhang Zhenghua, and Fu Caijun, filed a lawsuit with the Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, due to a dispute over compensation for work-related injury benefits between Fu Yunshan and the defendant, Lianyungang Development Zone Huayuan Municipal Garden Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huayuan Company).

The plaintiffs, Fu Hengsheng, Zhang Zhenghua, and Fu Caijun alleged: The plaintiffs' relative Fu Yunshan worked for the defendant in sanitation and cleaning since August 2006. On December 14, 2008, Fu Yunshan suffered a traffic accident injury while cleaning. On August 30, 2011, the Lianyungang Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security issued a work-related injury determination (Lian Ren She Gong Shang Kai Ren Zi [2011] No. 98) finding that Fu Yunshan's injury and condition constituted a work-related injury. On March 27, 2012, the Lianyungang Municipal Labor Ability Evaluation Committee rated Fu Yunshan's work-related injury disability as Grade V. The plaintiffs applied for arbitration to the Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone Labor Dispute Arbitration Committee in March 2013, and the Arbitration Committee issued a termination confirmation (No. 2013-027) on September 28, 2014. The plaintiffs requested a judgment ordering the defendant to pay medical expenses, hospitalization meal subsidies, nursing fees, disability subsidies, disability allowance, wages, one-time medical subsidy, and one-time employment subsidy totaling RMB 161,365. During the trial, the plaintiffs amended the compensation items, requesting the defendant to pay: pay during the period for suspension of work with medical treatment (stopping work but retaining salary period) of RMB 43,700, one-time disability subsidy of RMB 24,642, one-time work-related injury medical subsidy of RMB 69,119.4, and one-time disability employment subsidy of RMB 14,109, totaling RMB 151,570.4.

The defendant, Huayuan Company, defended: Fu Yunshan was a salt farm worker enjoying social insurance. During his internal retirement, he worked for the defendant, and the defendant could not pay social insurance for him. The relationship between the parties should be an employment relationship. This case has exceeded the statute of limitations.

The Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City found at first instance:

On December 14, 2008, the plaintiffs' relative, Fu Yunshan, was injured in a traffic accident while working for the defendant, Huayuan Company. On December 15, 2009, Fu Yunshan applied for labor arbitration to the Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone Labor Dispute Arbitration Committee, requesting confirmation of the existence of a labor relationship with the defendant. The committee confirmed the termination of the case with a termination confirmation (No. 2010-023). Fu Yunshan disagreed and filed a lawsuit with the court. The Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City, by Civil Judgment (2011) Gang Min Chu Zi No. 104, determined that a labor relationship existed between Fu Yunshan and the defendant from August 2006 to June 2010. This judgment was upheld on appeal. On August 30, 2011, Fu Yunshan was confirmed by the Lianyungang Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security to have suffered a work-related injury, and was rated as Grade V work-related injury disability by the Lianyungang Municipal Labor Ability Evaluation Committee. On March 22, 2013, Fu Yunshan applied for arbitration to the Lianyungang Economic and Technological Development Zone Labor Dispute Arbitration Committee for work-related injury compensation. The committee terminated the case on September 28, 2014, with a termination confirmation (No. 2013-027). On December 9, 2013, Fu Yunshan died of illness. During the trial, the three plaintiffs applied to change the litigation subjects to participate as plaintiffs. It was also found that Fu Yunshan was born on June 23, 1955; plaintiff Fu Hengshan is his father, plaintiff Zhang Zhenghua is his wife, and plaintiff Fu Caijun is his son. Fu Yunshan filed a civil compensation claim against the tortfeasor for the same traffic accident and was assessed for disability on June 24, 2009. The Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City, by Civil Judgment (2009) Gang Min Yi Chu Zi No. 0845, confirmed the plaintiff's period for suspension of work with medical treatment (stopping work but retaining salary period) from the date of injury to the day before the disability assessment.

The Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City held at first instance:

The statute of limitations has not passed in this case because Fu Yunshan had been continuously asserting his rights. The relationship between an internal retiree who has not reached the statutory retirement age and a new employer constitutes a labor relationship. Even if the original employer has paid work-related injury insurance premiums for the internal retiree, the new employer should, from the date of employment, handle the transfer procedures for the worker's work-related injury insurance and continue to pay the premiums, thereby achieving the legislative purpose of dispersing the employer's employment risk and protecting the lawful rights and interests of workers with work-related injuries. If the new employer fails to fulfill this legal obligation and the worker suffers a work-related injury during the period of working for that employer, the actual employer shall bear the legal obligation to pay work-related injury benefits according to law. It has been confirmed by the effective Civil Judgment (2011) Gang Min Chu Zi No. 01014 that a labor relationship existed between Fu Yunshan and the defendant, Huayuan Company, from August 2006 to June 2010. Since Fu Yunshan suffered a traffic accident injury while performing sanitation work for the defendant on December 14, 2008, the defendant shall, according to law, bear the liability for compensating Fu Yunshan for the losses of various benefits arising from the work-related injury. Fu Yunshan was determined to have a work-related injury and was rated as Grade V disability by the Lianyungang Municipal Labor Ability Evaluation Committee after the injury, which the court confirms. Regarding the arbitration application and various expenses of Fu Yunshan, the court finds as follows:

1. Pay during the period for suspension of work with medical treatment (stopping work but retaining salary period): RMB 43,700. The period for suspension of work with medical treatment of Fu Yunshan was confirmed by Civil Judgment (2009) Gang Min Yi Chu Zi No. 0845 from the date of injury to the day before the disability assessment (Fu Yunshan was assessed for disability on June 24, 2009). Fu Yunshan's claim based on a calculation of 12 months, without providing evidence, was not accepted. In 2008, the social insurance contribution base in Lianyungang City was RMB 1,369, and Fu Yunshan's pay during the period for suspension of work with medical treatment should be RMB 8,670 (6 months × RMB 1,369/month + RMB 1,369/30 days × 10 days).

2. One-time disability subsidy: RMB 24,642. Based on Fu Yunshan's Grade V disability, his one-time disability subsidy is RMB 24,642.

3. One-time work-related injury medical subsidy: RMB 69,119.4. Fu Yunshan terminated his labor relationship with the defendant in 2010, so the work-related injury medical subsidy should be calculated based on the average wage of local workers in Lianyungang City in 2009, which was RMB 28,212/year. According to statistical data, the local average life expectancy is 76 years. Fu Yunshan's one-time work-related injury medical subsidy should be RMB 69,119.4 (21 years × 1.4 months/year × RMB 28,218/12 months).

4. One-time disability employment subsidy: RMB 14,109. Fu Yunshan terminated his labor relationship with the defendant in June 2010, when he was over 55 years old, and should receive six months' local average wage, calculated based on the average wage of local workers in Lianyungang City in 2009, which was RMB 28,212/year. Therefore, the plaintiffs' claim for a one-time disability employment subsidy of RMB 14,109 (6 months × RMB 28,212/12 months) is supported.

In summary, the Lianyun District People's Court of Lianyungang City, in accordance with Article 36, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance, Articles 22 and 24 of the Measures for Implementing the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance in Jiangsu Province, and Article 64, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered a judgment on December 20, 2014:

The defendant, Huayuan Company, shall pay the plaintiffs, Fu Hengsheng, Zhang Zhenghua, and Fu Caijun, work-related injury compensation totaling RMB 116,084.4 within 10 days from the date this judgment takes legal effect.

Huayuan Company appealed to the Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court, alleging: 1. Fu Yunshan was an employee and had already received compensation for the traffic accident, so the appellant should not bear compensation liability. 2. The trial court's determination of compensation items and amounts was erroneous. It requested a judgment to reverse and rule that the appellant bore no liability, or to remand for retrial. During the hearing organized by the Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court, Huayuan Company added four points: (1) The social insurance contribution base for Lianyungang City in 2008 was RMB 890, not RMB 1,369, so the trial court's calculation of pay during the period for suspension of work with medical treatment was erroneous; (2) Fu Yunshan's monthly salary was about RMB 800, so the trial court's calculation of the one-time disability subsidy was erroneous; (3) According to the latest interpretation, effective June 1, 2015, there is no item for a one-time work-related injury medical subsidy; (4) Fu Yunshan had exceeded the statutory retirement age, so he should not receive a one-time disability subsidy.

The appellees, Fu Hengsheng, Zhang Zhenghua, and Fu Caijun, responded: 1. The trial court's findings of fact were clear and the application of law was correct; 2. The appellant, Huayuan Company, provided no evidence that the social insurance contribution base in Lianyungang City in 2008 was RMB 890; in the trial court, the appellant had submitted evidence showing it was RMB 1,369; 3. The regulation regarding the absence of a one-time medical subsidy claimed by the appellant took effect this year, while the work-related injury in this case occurred several years ago, so this regulation does not apply; 4. There is no clear legal provision that Fu Yunshan, having reached retirement age, is not entitled to an employment subsidy, so the appellant's argument is unfounded; 5. The trial court found that the evidence submitted by the appellant regarding Fu Yunshan's salary lacked objectivity and therefore did not accept the appellant's claim. They requested that the original judgment be affirmed.

The Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court, after the second instance trial, confirmed the facts found at first instance.

The Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court held at second instance:

Parties have the responsibility to provide evidence supporting their own claims. In this case, the appellant, Huayuan Company, failed to provide legally valid evidence to prove its assertions. Article 64, Paragraph 2 of the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance provides that the term "personal wage" as used in these Regulations refers to the average monthly wage on which social insurance contributions were based for the 12 months preceding the work-related accident or diagnosis of occupational disease. The trial court's determination of the social insurance contribution base for 2008 and the corresponding calculation of work-related injury insurance benefits were not improper.

In summary, the trial court's judgment had clear findings of fact and correct application of law. Accordingly, the Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 169 and Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered a judgment on July 3, 2015:

The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed.

This judgment is final.
